fields.title: CRIPC/MBRS registry search-result record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt/searchType (and _error/_errorDetail on failures, or _warning on partial degradation). Each successful record is one matched entity (searchType=entity) or owner (searchType=individual) from CRIPC/MBRS's public search, parsed from the site's own server-rendered HTML.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact query (name) that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-html-search (search-result row only), S1-html-search+owner-detail (individual row enriched with the owner-detail page), or none (error record).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed searches -- not_found (search matched nothing) or blocked_or_transient (network issue).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

_warning.title: Warning
_warning.description: pagination_truncated_by_page_cap if the safety page-depth cap was hit before maxResultsPerQuery, or owner_detail_fetch_partially_failed if one or more owner-detail lookups failed (base search fields are still included either way).

searchType.title: Search type
searchType.description: 'entity' (company/business-name search) or 'individual' (owner-name search), matching the run's input.

registrationNumber.title: Registration number
registrationNumber.description: CRIPC's public registration number -- prefixed COY- for incorporated companies, BRN- for registered business names/sole traders. Present on entity records and on the businesses[] entries of enriched individual records.

name.title: Name
name.description: Registered company/business name (entity records) or the owner's own name (individual records).

registeredDate.title: Registered date
registeredDate.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the entity was registered, where shown by the register.

ownerId.title: Owner ID
ownerId.description: CRIPC's internal UUID for this individual (individual records only) -- used to fetch the owner-detail page.

ownerDetailUrl.title: Owner detail URL
ownerDetailUrl.description: The public detail page for this owner (individual records only).

ownerIdType.title: Owner ID type
ownerIdType.description: e.g. "citizen" -- present on individual records only when includeOwnerDetails was enabled.

businesses.title: Businesses
businesses.description: Every business this owner is a registered proprietor/owner of -- present on individual records only when includeOwnerDetails was enabled. Each entry has registrationNumber, name, registeredDate, status, and ownerType (e.g. "Proprietor").

_ownerDetailError.title: Owner detail error
_ownerDetailError.description: Present only when the owner-detail fetch for this specific individual failed -- the base search-result fields above are still populated.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across entity and individual records, and error rows.
